title: W3C Web Platform Working Group-relevant MDN issues
description: Issue filed on MDN Web Docs related to pages attached to technologies developed by W3C Web Platform Working Group

items.content_html:
MDN URL

https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Range

What specific section or headline is this issue about?

Instance Properties

What information was incorrect, unhelpful, or incomplete?

The Instance Properties section of the Range interface says that "There are no inherited properties."

Compare this to the Static Range page which says "The properties below are inherited from its parent interface, AbstractRange"

What did you expect to see?

I expected to see the Range interface documentation correctly indicate that it inherits its properties from its parent interface AbstractRange, as is done in the similar StaticRange interface.

No response
